stories.title: Run weekly Primal Dad check-in
stories.description: Execute the Sunday weekly check-in flow for the Primal Dad gamified life-tracking system. This is a recurring task that walks Gab through all 7 dimensions (STR, VO2, FGT, FLX, MND, FAM, WRK), collects self-reported data, ingests any new Garmin watch exports, calculates XP with streak multipliers and weekly caps, updates all computed state files, and delivers a verbal summary with week-over-week comparison.
acceptance: Read data/computed/current-stats.json to load current state (levels, XP, streak)
Check data/watch-imports/ for new Garmin CSV exports and parse if present
Determine the current ISO week number for the check-in period
Walk Gab through each of the 7 dimensions conversationally (2-3 quick questions each)
Calculate XP earned per dimension, respecting weekly caps (STR:60, VO2:60, FGT:70, FLX:50, MND:55, FAM:55, WRK:55)
Apply streak multiplier based on consecutive weeks completed
Check for level-ups in any dimension
Write weekly history file to data/history/YYYY-WXX.json
Update data/computed/current-stats.json with new XP totals, levels, and streak
Update dashboard.html with new inline STATS object
Deliver verbal summary: overall level/title, level-ups, streak, weakest dimension callout, week-over-week delta
